Shapes.Text: • Market Growth: Ethiopia's facility management market is projected to grow from USD 2.90 billion in 2026 to USD 6.39 billion by 2033.• Strong Growth Rate: Expanding at a CAGR of 11.92% during 2026–2033.• Rising Demand: Urbanization, commercial real estate growth, and outsourcing drive demand for cleaning, security, and property management.• The Need: To stay competitive, HAB must modernize operations, improve efficiency, and deliver higher service quality.
